claim_scope: One-record train-only CPU integration smoke of the latest Transfer-DG adaptation core on an in-progress PyramidMoE checkpoint. This is seen-data diagnostic evidence only, not a validation, test_id, runtime, generalization, or target claim.
hypothesis: A deterministic ridge solve over the checkpoint's learned branch-trunk pressure modes, using exactly two adjacent onset frames and internal DG flux defects, will lower the online objective and lower future-field relative L2 for train_marmousi_00260 relative to the same unadapted update-13650 prediction.
expected_mechanism: Input-conditioned branch-trunk rank contributions span learned phase and amplitude corrections. Whitening makes their ridge scaling comparable, while the onset mismatch and internal normal-flux defect select a trust-bounded linear combination without reading future truth.
primary_metric: Post-seal adapted future-field relative L2 versus the unadapted update-13650 prediction on all stored frames strictly after the second onset observation.
failure_signal: Reject on binding drift, non-finite tensors, invalid two-frame access, singular effective basis, failed online objective gate, future-field regression, process failure, or any validation/test_id access.

data.online_true_frames: exactly two adjacent onset frames selected by the frozen one-cycle lead rule
data.future_truth_policy: Future train truth may be opened only after adapted coefficients and the no-future-access audit are serialized.

adaptation.basis: 64 input-conditioned physical branch-trunk rank contributions captured from the frozen model, hard-free-surface projected, phase rotated, Gram-whitened, and scaled to parent_norm/sqrt(effective_rank)
adaptation.volume_weight_reason: The real-cache source forcing normalization is not yet bound to the pressure Helmholtz residual, so the first integration smoke excludes the volume term rather than use a mismatched source scale.
adaptation.precision: full FP32 model, basis, ridge system, and adapted coefficients

rollback: Preserve the immutable update-13650 snapshot and every existing checkpoint. The active four-GPU pretraining process is untouched; adaptation writes only into the versioned run directory.
